name: guardian-throw-out
notes: CL-62: the aftermath. The guardian walks out of its cave on its hind legs with what is left of the marine carried low in its right hand (the carry clip), sets its feet, hauls him back over its head and throws him out onto the apron (the throw clip; the hold lets go at the clip's release event, so he flies with the hands). He is a simulated body the whole way (studio/motion.js, the marine preset), dead from the start: carried, he hangs from the chest in its right hand; thrown, he tumbles, lands and settles. Scene +Z is out of the cave; the game lays the path from the real mouth. CL-104 (Jerry 2026-09-29): one hand, held inside the curl of its fingers; out of the dark faster (3.6 m/s, not 2.4) and straight into the toss. After the toss it settles back onto its feet and breathes (the stand clip), rather than holding the throw.
